project.name: prx
project.tagline: the agent-run PR contract / work-unit CLI
project.description: The agent-run PR-contract CLI: it drives each work unit from plan through implementation, CI, and review to a merged PR as a signed, policy-enforced derivation chain run by capability-scoped agents — and ships the @bounded-systems libraries (policy, provenance, capability seams, content-addressed storage) it is built on.
